entities.name: Comitant Dovid
entities.description: An elderly cathar and veteran of the Pale serving the angels of the Lofts of Thraben Cathedral at Avacyn's request.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel who saved Dovid and tasked him with cleaning the Lofts; created by Sorin Markov.

entities.name: Gryta
entities.description: An angel of the Flight of Herons who tasked Dovid with cleaning the Lofts and later gave him a sword.

entities.name: Lofts of Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: A long abandoned cathedral Dovid cleaned so angels could use it as a place of rest.

entities.name: Mikaeus Cecani
entities.description: A deceased Lunarch whose journal detailed the entrapment of Avacyn and the origin of vampires.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon entrapped with Avacyn in the Helvault.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison in which Avacyn and Griselbrand were entrapped; later broken.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: The man who created vampires through a pact with the demon Shilgengar and the blood of the angel Marycz.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: A demon with whom Edgar Markov made a pact.

entities.name: Marycz
entities.description: An angel whose blood was drained to create vampires.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Edgar's vampire son who created Avacyn.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church designed to give humans power to protect and grow their numbers but never win against the vampires.

entities.name: Pale
entities.description: The cathar order Dovid once belonged to.

entities.name: Child's Wall
entities.description: Site of the battle where Dovid was grievously wounded.

entities.name: Eost
entities.description: A sword forged from shards of the broken Helvault, given to Dovid by Gryta.

events.summary: Dovid is grievously wounded at the battle of Child's Wall and saved by Avacyn's arrival, but can no longer wield a sword.
events.quote: He was grievously wounded at the battle of Child's Wall but was saved by the arrival of Avacyn and her flight.

events.summary: Avacyn and Gryta task Dovid with cleaning out the abandoned Lofts of Thraben Cathedral.
events.quote: tasked Dovid with cleaning out the long abandoned Lofts of Thraben cathedral

events.summary: In the Lofts Dovid finds a preserved strangled man in a cistern with the journal of Lunarch Mikaeus Cecani.
events.quote: It was the journal of the deceased Lunarch Mikaeus Cecani

events.summary: Dovid learns from the journal that Edgar Markov created vampires through a pact with Shilgengar and the blood of Marycz.
events.quote: Dovid was shocked at learning that the terrible vampires feeding on his people were created by none other than the very humans themselves.

events.summary: Dovid reads that Sorin Markov created Avacyn to preserve humans so vampires could keep feeding on them.
events.quote: Edgar's son Sorin Markov , also a vampire, created Avacyn

events.summary: Dovid reels at learning humans are livestock and his church and Avacyn unwitting shepherds, entering a deep crisis of faith.
events.quote: caused him to enter a deep crisis of faith

events.summary: Gryta rewards Dovid with a sword forged from Helvault shards, named Eost; Dovid hangs it on his wall and begins recording his findings.

relations.note: serves the angels at Avacyn's request
relations.quote: now serving the angels of the Lofts of Thraben Cathedral at Avacyn 's request

relations.note: created her as a force to rally angels
relations.quote: Edgar's son Sorin Markov , also a vampire, created Avacyn

relations.note: used her blood to create vampires
relations.quote: Edgar Markov created his foul race of vampires

relations.note: once a cathar of the Pale
relations.quote: Dovid was once a cathar of the Pale
